meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理地理数据时,本地检查并给出操作指导
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常用 Python 分析带地理坐标的数据,需要确保操作正确。
copy.tagline_en: Run local audits and get guidance on geospatial data handling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often analyze geographic data in Python and want to keep your methods correct.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你读写 Shapefile、GeoJSON、GeoPackage、PostGIS 等矢量地理数据,执行缓冲区、空间连接、叠加、裁剪、投影转换和地图绘制,并给出可运行的 Python 代码。
howto.when: 当你要求读写矢量地理数据、做缓冲区或空间连接等空间分析,或绘制分级设色地图时触发。

say.text: 读入 data.geojson,检查 CRS 后重投影到 EPSG:3857
say.note: 会输出数据与投影后的结果

say.text: 把 points 和 polygons 做空间连接,按多边形汇总 value
say.note: 会返回连接并聚合后的表

say.text: 用 population 字段画一张分级设色图并保存

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads and writes vector geospatial data (Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, PostGIS) and runs buffer, spatial join, overlay, clipping, reprojection and mapping, giving runnable Python code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to read or write vector geographic data, run spatial analysis such as buffers or spatial joins, or create choropleth maps.

say_en.text: Read data.geojson, check its CRS, then reproject to EPSG:3857
say_en.note: Returns the data and reprojected result

say_en.text: Spatially join points to polygons and aggregate value by polygon
say_en.note: Returns the joined and grouped table

say_en.text: Plot a choropleth of the population column and save it
